title: Battle of Waterloo
summary: On 18 June 1815 Napoleon's French army fought a coalition led by Wellington and Blücher near Brussels and was defeated. The battle ended Napoleon's imperial power; he was forced to abdicate when the Allies entered Paris on 7 July. It closed a war that had lasted 23 years.

uncertainty.note: Single-day battle per National Army Museum.

where.modern_name: Waterloo battlefield (pin at the Lion's Mound monument, a proxy), near Waterloo, Belgium
where.historical_name: Near Waterloo, south of Brussels (Smithsonian: near Brussels)

importance.justification: Decisive battle that ended Napoleon's imperial power after a 23-year war.

audience_note: Battle with heavy loss of life; an estimated 20,000 men died, per Smithsonian Magazine.

sources.title: Archaeologists Uncover Rare Human Skeleton at Waterloo
